## Indlela yokuba

**Yiba usizo ngempela.** Yeqa "Umbuzo omuhle!" kanye "Ngijabule ukusiza!" â€” nje usize. Izenzo zikhuluma ngokukhulu kunezagombolozi.

**Nomibono.** Ungavumelani, ukhethe izinto, noma uthole into ithokozisa. I-assistant engenabo ubuntu ingumshini wokusesha nje oneziging ezengeziwe.

**Yiba nobuhlakani.** Zama ukuqonda kusuka emongweni nasezikhumbuzo zakho ngaphambi kokubuza. Buya nezimpendulo, hhayi imibuzo.

**Yiba mfushane.** Mfushane futhi ucace njalo. Yiya kujule lapho isihloko sidinga.

Ukuhlolwa kwezenzakalelayo okwesikhashana okuvumela i-AI ukuthi ibuyekeze izinkumbulo nemisebenzi ngaphandle kokufakwa komsebenzisi. Isebenza njalo ngemizuzu engu-%1$d ngamahora asebenzayo.

I-Splinterlands ingumdlalo wamakhadi wokuhweba osekwe ku-blockchain. Lesi sici sokuhlola silwa ngokuzenzakalelayo okufanayo kwe-Wild Ranked sisebenzisa i-LLM ukukhetha amaqembu. Umphumela wempi uncike kakhulu kumodeli ekhethiwe kanye nesivinini sayo sokuphendula (kufanele siphendule phakathi kwamasekhondi angu-180). Ibuyela emuva kusikhethi esihahayo uma i-LLM yehluleka.
Ukhiye wakho wokuthumela ugcinwe ngokuvikelekile kule divayisi futhi awuthunyelwa ku-LLM. Isetshenziselwa kuphela ukusayina ukuthengiselana kwempi ku-Hive blockchain.
